ValueBaseUtils.luau.description: Provides utilities for working with ValueBase objects, like [IntValue] or [ObjectValue] in Roblox. Public entry points include `ValueBaseUtils.isValueBase`, `ValueBaseUtils.getValueBaseType`, `ValueBaseUtils.getClassNameFromType`, `ValueBaseUtils.getOrCreateValue`, `ValueBaseUtils.setValue`, `ValueBaseUtils.getValue`, `ValueBaseUtils.createGetSet`.
